text_block_list.text:
I'm walking by the station on one of my
days off,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is where I'm supposed to meet
Taiki.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Are you... Suzuka?
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Uh, yeah. I am...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh! It's really you!
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I drew a picture of you and
sent it to
you with a letter a while back!
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you the one who drew the
picture of me
at my concert?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yep! So you read my letter?
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the drawing was so cute. Thank
you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'll send you another one! Oh, I've gotta
go! Keep
up the great work in your
races! Bye-bye!
text_block_list.name: Девочка А

text_block_list.text: Mhm, bye-bye.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Wow! Ain't you cute, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Whoa, Taiki?! You surprised me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: No, I'm the one who's surprised!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I've never seen ya lookin' so happy
before!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: R-really? Do I really look that happy?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
...Huh, I guess my heart does feel kind of
warm...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Of course you do!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Fan letters sure do spark up your spirit! I
know
they always sharpen my focus and
boost my
mood!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
So this is what it's like to have fans... It's
nice.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You bet your tail! Oh, I just thought of
somethin'
real good!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
How about we go do some trainin' so
you can
keep up that happy face for the
rest of your
days?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Um, I think I'll pass.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Despite being rejected, Тайки Шаттл
follows
Сайленс Судзука around for the
rest of the day,
trying to make her smile
again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
